title: Verifier-owned lifecycle omits the explicit current-edge migration selection

discovery.error: Automatic baseline/latest inference is forbidden; specify MigrationVersion or FromVersion/ToVersion.

rootCause: The verifier-owned orchestrator directly invokes the fail-closed migration executor without freezing a current-edge version, although the canonical lifecycle policy requires discovery from checksum manifests and the executor requires an explicit selection.
repair: Discover one common current edge from official checksum manifests, fail on vendor disagreement or malformed entries, record the frozen version in Evidence, and pass it explicitly to rollback, upgrade and rollback-reapply planning/execution.
sourceFix: Verifier discovery reads every official checksum manifest, requires one common maximum edge, records CHECKSUM_MANIFEST_CURRENT_EDGE, and passes the frozen version explicitly to every non-Fresh lifecycle plan/execution and pre-current rollback.
targetedVerification: Verifier-owned runtime contract, immutable generation guard, and MariaDB profile verify suites PASS 19/19; actual V135 lifecycle pending.
